author: St. Thomas More
name: The Confutation of Tyndale's Answer, Part I
name_pt: A Refutação da Resposta de Tyndale, Parte I
desc: The first part of More's longest work (1532): a point-by-point reply to William Tyndale's Answer to More's Dialogue, on the Church, the sacraments, images, saints and the Scriptures.
desc_pt: A primeira parte da maior obra de More (1532): resposta ponto a ponto à Resposta de William Tyndale ao Diálogo, sobre a Igreja, os sacramentos, as imagens, os santos e as Escrituras.
edition: The co[n]futacyon of Tyndales answere (London: 1532), EEBO-TCP A07693.
